resources.string: Select a track and wait for it to load.

The selected track is decoded locally and displayed at its playback position, including while muted. Waveform mode shows left and right channels in blue and orange. X-Y mode uses the left channel as the horizontal axis and the right as the vertical axis; mono audio forms a diagonal line. Only an 8-second PCM window near playback is cached at a time and deleted on close. The graph shows source audio before speed, pitch and device effects.
